列表页的表格：带类型的列定义、自定义单元格、行选择、受控分页，内置加载骨架和空状: The table of list pages: typed column definitions, custom cells, row selection and controlled pagination, with a loading skeleton and an empty state built in. Row actions use RowActions; dangerous actions are confirmed with ConfirmAction. There is no sorting and no sticky header: sort through the API's query parameters, and page long lists.
给列数组标注 DataTableColumn<Row>[]，dataIndex: Annotate the columns array as DataTableColumn<Row>[] so dataIndex can only be a field of the row. A column without render shows the value as is; empty values show -.
render 拿到的 value 按 dataIndex 推断类型：状态用 St: render's value is typed from dataIndex: status as a StatusBadge, amounts right-aligned and formatted, times converted to the local time zone.
selectedKeys 由页面管理；有选中行时工具栏显示数量和批量操作，删除前: The page owns selectedKeys; while rows are selected the toolbar shows the count and the batch actions, and deleting asks for confirmation with ConfirmAction.
页码由页面管理，onChange 里切换页码；接口分页时把 items 和 to: The page owns the page number and changes it in onChange; with API paging, pass in items and total (useCrudList already does this).
首次加载显示骨架行，刷新时保留旧数据并变暗；没有数据时显示空状态和下一步操作。: The first load shows skeleton rows; a refresh keeps the old rows, dimmed; with no data the empty state shows the next step.
前两个操作显示为按钮，其余收进「更多」菜单；删除用 render 包一层 Con: The first two actions are buttons, the rest go into the "More" menu; delete wraps its button in ConfirmAction through render.
放进 Panel 时去掉边框，dense 紧凑行高，minWidth 让窄屏横向: Inside a Panel the border is dropped; dense makes rows compact; minWidth makes narrow screens scroll horizontally; onRowClick and rowClassName mark the current row and delayed shipments.
勾选行后可以批量操作: Select rows to act on them together
订单付款后会自动生成发票。: An invoice is created when an order is paid.
点击一行查看: Click a row to select it
当前页的行: The rows of the current page
行的唯一标识：React key，也是选择的值: Each row's identity: the React key and the selection value
没有数据时显示骨架行，已有数据时把行变暗: Skeleton rows while there is no data yet; dims the rows otherwise
分页（page 从 1 开始）；不传则不显示分页: Pagination (page starts at 1); omit it to hide pagination
勾选变化时调用，传入新的 key 列表: Called when the selection changes, with the new list of keys
点击行；传了之后行显示手型光标: Row click; when set, rows show a pointer cursor
空状态标题（中文原文，组件内翻译）: Empty state title (Chinese source text, translated by the component)
空状态说明，写下一步做什么: Empty state description: say what to do next
空状态里的按钮: A button in the empty state
外层卡片边框；放在 Panel 里时设为 false: Outer card border; set to false inside a Panel
表格最小宽度，容器更窄时横向滚动: Table min width; narrower containers scroll horizontally
React key；缺省时用 dataIndex，再缺省用列序号: React key; defaults to dataIndex, then the column index
表头（中文原文，组件内翻译）: Header (Chinese source text, translated by the component)
读取的字段；render 的 value 按这个字段推断类型: The field to read; render's value is typed from it
自定义单元格；没有 dataIndex 时 value 为 undefined: Custom cell; value is undefined without dataIndex
对齐；数字列用 right + tabular-nums: Alignment; number columns use right + tabular-nums
单行省略，文本单元格悬停显示全文: One line with an ellipsis; text cells show the full text on hover
操作列表；假值会被跳过，可以写 cond && { … }: The actions; falsy entries are skipped, so cond && { … } works
前几个可见操作显示为按钮，其余收进「更多」菜单: How many visible actions are buttons; the rest go into the "More" menu
按钮文字（中文原文，组件内翻译），同一行内唯一: Button text (Chinese source text, translated by the component), unique within a row
自定义内联内容，例如用 ConfirmAction 包住的删除按钮（只对内联操作: Custom inline content, e.g. a delete button wrapped in ConfirmAction (inline actions only)
这一行不显示该操作: Leaves the action out for this row
